transcript_only_text:
I think tons of people work as hard as
me. If you go to China, tons of people work, you know, 12 days a week, 12 hours
a day, you know, six or seven days a week. But at that point, once you
maximize the amount of work that you actually do, it comes down to what you
get for what you put in. They spend all their time quote working, but they don't
get a lot done. And so, the 201 level is learning how to get a lot done with your
time. The 301 level is only choosing to do things that even give you bigger
multiples in your time. And I think the fourth level of that is finding other
people to do those things for you and do them better. It's just a constant
leveling up.
